examples: Pick a light-on-dark palette that is easier on the eyes late at night.
how_to: Browse the installed themes; filter by favorites, built in, yours or ASCII.
Click one to preview it, then make it the page theme or star it as a favorite.
To share one, open it and press export: its theme.json is saved. Themes install only from the catalog, which checks a signed release.
name: Theme system
summary: choose from more than twenty bundled color themes, or write your own.
where: Or the THEMES card on the home screen.
